description:
At Commure, we're building the AI Operating System for healthcare, the foundation that defines how care is delivered, documented, and financed. Our platform spans the full care journey: Ambient AI and Dictation eliminating documentation burden at the point of care, intelligent Agents automating patient and revenue workflows, and autonomous RCM processing billions in claims, all on a single AI-native platform integrated with 60+ EHRs.

Healthcare carries a $1 trillion administrative burden and we're at the center of transforming it. Today, 500,000+ clinicians across 500+ healthcare organizations nationwide trust Commure to handle $25B+ in annual claims and support over 200 million patient interactions. Our latest $70M raise at a $7B valuation reflects the confidence the market has placed in this mission. We've also been named to the Fortune Future 50 list and the 2026 AI Breakthrough Awards for “Overall NLP Company of the Year.”

Our team works directly alongside clinicians, not through layers of process, which means the gap between what you build and its impact on patient care is immediate. We move fast, deploy daily, and take full ownership from early thinking to production. If you're energized by hard problems, high stakes, and a team that holds itself to a high bar, you'll find your people here.

The future of healthcare is being built right now. Come deliver this transformation.

About the Role

Sales Engineers at Athelas sit at the center of every deal. You’ll work alongside our account executives to run discovery, build and deliver product demos, scope implementations, and help win some of the largest opportunities in healthcare. You’ll also be the voice of the customer back to our product and engineering teams. This role is a good fit for a technical person who enjoys being in front of customers and wants to understand how healthcare organizations actually run, from the front desk to the back office.

How the Program Works

New SEs rotate across our product lines:

  • Ambient AI: AI scribe and clinical documentation

  • AI Voice Agents: Automated call center agents to help manage the front desk

  • Air EHR: Our electronic health record and practice platform

  • Revenue Cycle Management: Managed Services and Practice Management solutions

After your rotations, we’ll place you based on what is the strongest fit for you and where the business needs you. Every SE is trained across the full suite and can jump in on any deal, but you’ll go deep on a core set of products.

What You’ll Do:

  • Technical Demonstrations: Prepare and deliver compelling technical demos to explain how our products and services function, highlighting their unique value propositions and benefits.

  • Run Discovery and Scoping: Collaborate with customers and our engineering/ops team to ensure our platform meets integration/functional requirements, addressing any technical challenges that arise.

  • Sales Support: Communicate effectively with the sales team to understand customer demands and provide necessary technical support during the sales process.

  • RFP Support: Sales Engineers have the opportunity to work on some of the biggest opportunities in healthcare via RFPs (Request for Proposal). The Sales Engineering team will help gather requirements, materials, and participate in technical demos/discussions with potential lighthouse customers.

  • Customer Relationships: Build and maintain strong rapport with customers, fostering trust and acceptance of our products and services.

  • Bridge customers and product: Bring customer requirements and feedback back to product and engineering, and help shape what we build next.

  • Problem Solving: Assist clients in resolving any issues related to product usage, providing expert guidance and support.

  • Set up implementations for success: Hand off clean, accurate scoping so our implementation and operations teams can deliver on what was sold.

What You Have

  • 2+ years in sales engineering, solutions consulting, implementation, or another customer-facing technical role

  • Experience in healthcare (EHR, revenue cycle, billing, or practice operations) is a big plus

  • Comfortable learning complex software quickly and explaining it simply to both technical and non-technical audiences

  • Strong written communication. You’ll write a lot, and it needs to be clear and accurate

  • Organized and able to juggle several active deals at once

  • Curious, low-ego, and happy to roll up your sleeves

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience

What We Offer:

  • Competitive salary, bonus, and equity

  • Benefits: health, dental, vision, 401(k), PTO, etc.

  • A seat on some of the biggest deals in healthcare tech

  • A clear path to grow, whether that’s deeper product specialization, leading deals, or moving into leadership

  • Flexible Location / Hybrid in NYC

If you are passionate about technology and sales and thrive in a collaborative environment, we would love to hear from you. Apply today to join our team and help drive our success!

Please be aware that all official communication from us will come exclusively from email addresses ending in @commure.com. Any emails from other domains are not affiliated with our organization.


Employees will act in accordance with the organization’s information security policies, to include but not limited to protecting assets from unauthorized access, disclosure, modification, destruction or interference nor execute particular security processes or activities. Employees will report to the information security office any confirmed or potential events or other risks to the organization. Employees will be required to attest to these requirements upon hire and on an annual basis.
